Ballista ammunition; the 3rd-rank fear (DC 19) hits creatures within 10 feet of the TARGET. No owner-side effect.
A purchased travel service. Route choice, travel time and encounter risk are GM/downtime adjudication with no sheet consequence.

Its only mechanical trick is lending its own etched runes to a holstered weapon and auto-reloading on return. Rune-borrowing exists in the engine only as the hardcoded Doubling Rings lane (derive.ts effectiveWeaponRunes / inv.copyRunesFrom, gated by DOUBLING_RINGS in derive.ts:1077 and the runeCopy UI in InventoryTab.tsx:1025); no legal item field expresses it, so there is no applicable fix. Its capacity/holster behaviour is already carried by capacity + ignoredBulk.

Interact-deployed tripod that braces a kickback weapon. The kickback trait's attack penalty is not tracked anywhere in the engine (no occurrence of 'kickback' in src/), so there is no penalty to cancel, and the steed's recoil protection is flavour.

The base ogre hook statistics are on the record (itemType weapon, martial, group pick, 1d10 slashing, 2 hands, deadly-d10 + trip traits) and the strike code reads them. Its '+1 striking' are fundamental runes, already modelled — the owner sets potency/striking on the weapon instance (build.inventory[].runes, consumed by derive.ts weaponStrike). The mythic activation (1 Mythic Point, line damage, self-healing off bleed dealt) is an activation resolved and gone in the same moment.
The text states outright that it 'produces no direct benefit for the wearer' — the scrying is done by the hag who made it. Correctly inert.

Same inert base item plus a once-per-day activation that forces a DC 19 Will save on a creature within 30 feet. Wholly target-side and resolved in the moment; the once/day limit is already carried by the record's frequency field.
Mundane 1 sp tool with no rules text at all. Nothing to deliver.

The activation casts a 2nd-rank illusory disguise on YOU, with no frequency on the record (the base handkerchief-of-disagreeable-disguise carries frequency 1/day and a counter; this greater version has neither, so it is at-will, matching masquerade-scarf-greater). Mundane 5 sp gloves with no rules text. Nothing to deliver.
Mundane 8 sp worn harness with no rules text. Nothing to deliver.

Consumable ammunition. Lodging, the DC 18 Escape/Force Open, the 50-foot tether and the tug-Trip all resolve against the TARGET; the -10-foot range reduction lasts only while that single round of ammunition is loaded and no field expresses a per-shot range change.
Mundane watertight case; whole content is holding a harrow deck. Pure flavour.
Mundane deck of cards; the text only describes material quality and gives permission to do harrow readings. No statistic.

Ancestry flavour item: it can substitute for your body in a resurrection spell/ritual and regrows via a day-long ritual. Entirely narrative/GM, with an explicit 'at the GM's discretion' clause.

Mundane tool whose whole content is permission — it is required to attempt Administer First Aid / Treat Disease / Treat Poison / Treat Wounds. The basic kit grants no bonus (only the expanded kit does), and the worn draw-as-part-of-the-action clause is an action-economy convenience.

Relic gift activation: a 15-foot cone healing you and living targets for 1d4 HP per relic level. Instantaneous healing applied at the table, no standing change; the once/hour limit is already on the record's frequency field.
Assistive worn item; the text describes its shape and the Interact to attach/remove. It grants no bonus, sense or precision change on the sheet.
As above with the magical trait; it transfers sound down the receiver but confers no listed sense, bonus or Perception change.

Relic gift. Protection from severe/extreme/incredible environmental cold has no field in the schema and is GM-side environmental adjudication (it is not cold resistance and must not be written as one — that would be an over-grant). The 1/day activation grants the concealed condition for 1 minute but explicitly can't be used to Hide or Sneak, so it is a table-tracked condition with no sheet number.

Protection from severe environmental cold only (explicitly none from extreme or incredible). Environmental protection has no field and is GM-adjudicated; writing it as cold resistance would be an over-grant.

A cursed intelligent toolset that fuses to you: instead of the tool's usual item bonus you take a -2 circumstance penalty to checks made with them. That is a standing owner-side check modifier and nothing carries it. The intelligent item's own Perception/skills/saves are the ITEM's statistics (GM-run), and the placate check to suppress the curse for 24 hours is table-resolved, so only the penalty is fixed here.

A weapon modification creating a hidden compartment; explicitly 'without greatly affecting its balance', so no weapon statistic changes. Finding it is a check made by someone else.

Delivered by the item record itself: itemType weapon, category simple, damage {dice:1,die:'d6',type:'spirit'}, range 20, with the thrown/splash/holy traits — the strike code reads those directly. The 1 spirit splash and the unholy-only restriction are the splash/holy traits resolved against the target.

Tattoo whose effects are that off-target teleportation to your home lands exactly, and a 1-action activation that senses the direction of home. Both are narrative/GM outcomes with no sheet statistic; the fade-if-home-is-lost clause is GM adjudication.

Each activation draws a RANDOM slip that becomes an ordinary item (armor, a potion, rope, a staff, rations...). Modelling it as effectChoices would let the player pick, which the item forbids; the drawn item is then owned and tracked normally as its own inventory entry.

Property rune, present in core.runes (slot weapon, kind property). It grants the trip trait — permission to attempt Trip against a TARGET — and a reactive Trip on a critical hit. Container record with no rules text in the corpus; its extradimensional storage is handled by the container lane. Nothing promised that is undelivered.
Purchasable pet that the source explicitly says cannot be combat trained or contribute to combat in any way. No sheet effect by design.

A contact poison applied to a VICTIM: DC 30 Fortitude, onset, and enfeebled stages plus halved healing all run on the poisoned creature, not the owner. Affliction stage tracking is table-side.

Property rune present in core.runes but with NO `damage` field, so the promised additional 1d6 force damage on a successful Strike never reaches the strike breakdown (derive.ts:1486/1694 read db.runes[p]?.damage — flaming ships this shape, impactful does not). Armor property rune present in core.runes. It makes you quickened only while you are under an effect that lasts until you Escape, and the extra action is restricted to Step or Escape. RuneDef carries only a `damage` rider, a mode needs a fromItemId an etched rune never has, and a standing quickened would be a severe over-grant. Table-tracked condition.

Wheelchair accessibility upgrade: it changes how the chair is controlled (fingers/nerve impulses) and explicitly does not help when you are grabbed or paralyzed. No speed, bonus or action change on the sheet.

Relic gift whose once-per-day activation grants the owner a heatsight PRECISE sense out to 30 feet for 1 minute — a timed sense the senses lane already models (compare item-bloodhound-mask-lesser / item-clockwork-goggles, which ship exactly this mode shape). Nothing currently delivers it.

mode.name: Incandescent Sight
mode.note: Detects temperature gradients out to 30 feet, so you can spot living creatures and warm objects in the dark. Warm objects block it even when transparent (e.g. hot water).
